nom: Codex Labs Shaant Pore Purifying Face Scrub

avis.titre: Would be great but would prefer a fragrance-free version; 93/100 on Yuka
avis.texte: This has a very fine texture to it so you don't feel like the physical exfoliant aspects are harsh, and of course the star ingredient is the salicylic acid which is a well-known and effective exfoliant. It was effective as a cleanser, but long-term, it's hard for me to evaluate since I don't love the fragrance. This has patchouli, which some may enjoy, but I don't find it necessary in a cleanser, and fragrances are one of the most common allergens. I think the other ingredients are solid, so this would be good choice for those who like fragranced products and know their skin is OK with the botanicals in this. While there is a photo of the ingredients, I'll list them here for those who find it easier to evaluate them in text format: 2% Salicylic acid, Aqua (Water), Propanediol, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Lactobacillus Ferment, Glyceryl Stearate, Silybum Marianum Ethyl Ester, Glycerin, Jojoba Esters, Cetyl Alcohol, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Lactobacillus, Betula Alba Bark Extract, Cetyl Palmitate, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Fruit Extract, Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract, Fucus Spiralis (Spiral Wrack) Extract, Tetraselmis Chui Extract, Ocimum Sanctum Leaf Oil, Pogostemon Cablin (Patchouli) Leaf Extract, Sorbitan Palmitate, Sorbitan Olivate, Octyldodecanol, Sclerotium Gum, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Hydroxide, Tocopherol, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Potassium Carbonate

avis.titre: Gentle Scrub that Includes Salicylic Acid
avis.texte: I like the fine grit of this scrub as I feel like it is more gentle, whereas large grit tends to be more harsh. I don't have to worry about it irritating my skin or making it raw and more sensitive. I already have sensitive skin so this is something that is important to me. I was pleasantly surprised that this item is scent free. I do not like added fragrances to my facial products, I find it unnecessary and often it causes skin irritation. This scrub does not make my skin red or dried out after using. The addition of sunflower seed oil and shea butter make sure it leaves your skin feeling hydrated and not tight and dry. The best part is that the scrub includes salicylic acid which helps aid in preventing blemishes. When I used the product I felt like it really got into my skin and removed the dead skin cells while also cleaning out my pores. My skin was glowing after I used the scrub, and felt very soft. I always follow up with a milk moisturizer after using. I plan to use this scrub 2-3 times a week to remove dead skin, and to keep my skin glowing and healthy.

avis.titre: Gentle product that really understands my temperamental skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive combination skin -- some parts are oily, while my chin and cheeks can be dry. I was hopeful that the Shaant Pore Purifying Acne Face Scrub from Codex Labs could help address some hormonal skin issues I've noticed. This scrub smells amazing! Botanical, herby, and earthy! I'm guessing that's due to the inclusion of the patchouli, shea, and oils. It is incredibly gentle and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight, dry, or itchy. I didn't have any exacerbation of issues and noticed some improvements already. I had a hard time getting the product to squeeze out of the opening on the top, so I found it easier to use after taking the entire cap off. I like the unusual geometric design on the cap. Product came nicely sealed with an expiration of 6/2025.

Gentle enough to use daily. Formula has a slight grit feeling, I mean very very slight. No irritation to skin or redness. Helps clean skin and make skin feel smooth. I don’t like the smell but it’s bareable.

avis.titre: Exfoliates and works well on my combination sensitive skin
avis.texte: This scrub exfoliates with small granules and it leaves my skin feeling well cleansed but not stripped. I use smaller than a pea sized portion, lather it and then apply it on my face. I leave it on for a few minutes and rinse it off. My skin feels soft, well cleansed but not irritated or sensitive. I don't use it daily, just once a week.
The smell was not great and I didn’t feel like it really exfoliated very well. It also dried my face out a little afterwards. Overall, I wouldn’t purchase again.

avis.titre: Unscented with the perfect amount of exfoliating fine grit
avis.texte: This cleanser works fantastic for cleaning off post cycling thick sunscreen and grime from riding on the streets. My skin is sensitive and reactive but I've not had any problems with this face scrub. It contains the perfect amount of fine grit to thoroughly clean my skin leaving it feel very clean and fresh. The salicylic acid helps exfoliate dead skin cells and encourage faster cell turnover. Great product!

This scrub is gentle on skin, it's purifying and my skin feels super smooth after use. It doesn't damage or dry out the skin, my skin feels hydrated refreshed. Just one con the smell is not very pleasing.
